svg.title: Carlos's engineering career: ilegra and Agibank, Mercado Livre, Nubank
svg.desc: 2019 to 2022: cloud training and banking backend development at ilegra, serving Agibank. 2022 to 2025: logistics systems at Mercado Livre. Since February 2025: senior software engineering at Nubank, first in customer-support AI and now on the Agentic Platform team, building SDKs, LLM gateways, MCP servers, and reusable components. Technology and platform capability labels are shown beside each role.
svg.text: A career built on backend systems

g.text: Logistics & S&OP · Async data science integrations
